name: Freedom Reads
head: Freedom Reads: what they want, what they hate, how they feel about us
about: Freedom Reads puts Freedom Libraries inside prisons and runs the Inside Literary Prize (ILP), judged by incarcerated readers. Dwayne is the founder and CEO. Chiari (Senior Director of Marketing and Communications) is new and sets the content direction. James (Communications) sends footage and reviews cuts. Our lead: Nick.

rel.note: Chiari joined as the new marketing lead and wants a planned content calendar built around Dwayne's events. James still reviews and posts. The Washington ILP cuts are next.

nps.note: Freedom Reads has never been surveyed.

ver.note: Last 90 days, 16 Freedom Reads cuts. Average V1.56 vs agency V1.96. Half went past V1, same as the agency.

read.chip: Likes the work, checks the words
read.note: When James approves, he says so fast. His notes are small word fixes: “for” Freedom Reads, never “with”. Typos in names, facilities and book titles are what send cuts back.

quotes.q: The videos are good, real good. I already posted one of Jason.
The video is powerful though and I want it to be a standalone. Adding some B-roll to highlight our library patrons and the libraries inside cellblocks would be good too.
I did look at the videos and they are good
The video is great… That is it. Post it

loves: One real person telling one concrete book or library story.
Single voice, straight to camera, dignity first.
B-roll of library patrons and Freedom Libraries inside cellblocks.
Real books on camera, with titles spelled exactly.
Full-circle stories: read inside, now part of the work.
hates: Sensational or sad-prison framing. Negative talk about a facility.
The word “inmates”. Last names on screen.
Typos in names, facilities and book titles.
“with Freedom Reads”. It is “for Freedom Reads”.
Readable ID badges or DOC numbers.
how_to_cut: “Freedom Reads” is two words, two r's. “ILP” always in capitals.
Captions low, long lines split in two, none on the end card.
Book titles capitalized exactly as printed.
Verify every institution name before it goes on screen.
Blur any ID badge or document in frame.
Each video gets its own end card. Check it is the right one.
Weekly Words text sits centered in a tan box.

perf.note: Instagram @freedombeginswithabook reels, last 90 days. Public data, views only. Tap a reel to watch it.
perf.foot: Person-first reels win. The San Quentin interviews did 1.6× the next reel. ILP judge reels sit around 1,250–1,900 views. The Washington tour stop is already posted once, so the three Washington cuts should feel new, not repeat it.

brand.note: Typical pairing: charcoal #292424 text on off-white #F2EBE8 or cream #FFE4B8. Captions use the cream box with dark text. Fonts are Metric2 and Redaction, licensed and self-hosted; ask Nick for files, never pull them from the website.

## Typo-QA Glossary
_Canonical on-screen spellings for the `typo-qa` tool. Mined 2026-05-31 from this client's MD + web-verified names. extract.sh reads the PRIME line to prime Whisper; the reader diffs captions against these._

PRIME: Freedom Reads, Weekly Words, Freedom Library, Freedom Zone, ILP, Dwayne Betts, James Davis, San Quentin, Niantic, Mellon, Caits Meissner, Cybulski, Heavy, Kiese Laymon, The Wretched of the Earth, Frantz Fanon, The Count of Monte Cristo, James, Percival Everett, SHU

- **Freedom Reads** — org name. Standing rule (line ~382): TWO words, TWO r's. NOT "FreedomReads", NOT "Freedom Read", NOT "Freedom Reeds".
- **Weekly Words** — signature series; appears as on-screen super centered in a tan box. Title case both words. NOT "weekly words", NOT "Weekly Word".
- **Freedom Library** — core program ("a Freedom Library in every cellblock"). Capitalized as a proper name. Plural "Freedom Libraries" also valid when referring to multiple.
- **Freedom Zone** — Freedom Reads installation/program named in the same standing rule as the org. Title case.
- **ILP** — Inside Literary Prize, always rendered as the acronym "ILP" in this client's material (e.g., "ILP judge Scott", "ILP Intro"). All-caps.
- **Dwayne Betts** — founder/CEO; the name that appears in supers. MD also shows "Reginald Betts" / "Reginald 'Dwayne' Betts" — full given-name form is web-unverified (see uncertain), so prime only the well-attested "Dwayne Betts".
- **James Davis** — primary Freedom Reads contact (Communications Associate); corroborated by james.davis@freedomreads.org. Common spelling, low risk.
- **San Quentin** — recurring facility/institution name (appears on subject name cards). Standing rule: verify all institution names. Two words, NOT "San Quinton".
- **Niantic** — CT location of the York/Niantic 500th-library shoot. NOT "Niantec".
- **Mellon** — the Mellon Foundation (funder, B-roll/edit context). NOT-pair: "Mellon" the foundation vs "melon" the fruit — Whisper/caption tools mishear this (the MD's own "Melon Visit 2" line is the internal slip).
- **Caits Meissner** — editor of *The Sentences That Create Us: Crafting a Writer's Life in Prison* (PEN America / Haymarket, 2022 — the book Freedom Reads speakers hold up on camera; 75K copies donated to prison libraries via Mellon). Web-verified 2026-07-04 (PEN America, Amazon, B&N). NOT "Kate Meisner", NOT "Kate Smeister" (Whisper mishears it that way — a CE01 caption shipped "Kate Meisner" and was flagged).
- **Cybulski** — Cybulski Community Reintegration Center / Willard-Cybulski CI, Enfield CT; FR opened Freedom Libraries there (42 across 3 CT prisons) and speakers reference being incarcerated there. Web-verified 2026-07-04 (freedomreads.org press release, CT DOC, Wikipedia). NOT "Cybowski" (two CE01 captions shipped that), NOT "Sibulski"/"Ceibulski" (Whisper mishears).
- **Heavy** / **Kiese Laymon** — *Heavy: An American Memoir* by Kiese Laymon; the book speakers hold on camera in the 2026-07 testimonial batch ("the book that freed me"). Capitalize "Heavy" when it's the title — CE01 captions shipped lowercase "heavy" repeatedly.
- **The Wretched of the Earth** / **Frantz Fanon** — added to PRIME 2026-08-08 after a typo-qa run on `FREEDOMREADSBooksTransformTheWorld001` V4: Whisper rendered the spoken title as **"the Russia of the Earth"** in the gold while the on-screen caption had it RIGHT ("The Wretched of the Earth"). Un-primed, the audio gold is the wrong side on this title — prime it so the gold stops fighting a correct caption. The 60th-anniversary edition cover is held up on camera through most of that cut (it also floods `chunkseq.py`'s caption-height filter — read crops directly on this batch).
- **The Count of Monte Cristo** — primed 2026-08-08; CE01 captions shipped "the count of money crystal" (flagged on `FREEDOMREADSMentalFurlough001` V1, fixed by V6).
- **James** / **Percival Everett** — *James* (Percival Everett, Doubleday 2024; Pulitzer Prize for Fiction 2025), the Huck Finn retelling told from Jim's side. Added to PRIME 2026-08-11 after the typo-qa pass on `FREEDOMREADSJamesByPercivalEverett001` V2, where the on-screen caption had BOTH right ("called James, by Percival Everett.") — primed so a future gold doesn't fight a correct caption, and because the bare first name "James" collides with the **James Davis** contact entry above (judge by context: "James by Percival Everett" = the book; "James" alone in a name super = the contact).
- **SHU** — Special Housing Unit (solitary confinement), spoken by formerly incarcerated speakers as "the shoe". Added to PRIME 2026-08-11: CE01 captions shipped the phonetic **"I was in a shoe"** on TWO cuts of the same interview (`FREEDOMREADSBooksKeptMyMindFree001` + `FREEDOMREADSBooksSetMyMindFree001`), both corrected to "in the SHU" at V2 on an editors@ note. All-caps, "the SHU" (not "a SHU"). This is a recurring class — every speaker describing solitary will trip it.

## Goals & Preferences
**North-star / mission angle.** Freedom Reads = human transformation through books and Freedom Libraries inside prisons. Content leads with a **specific person's story** — formerly incarcerated staff, incarcerated readers, family — connecting a book/library to a changed life ("full circle" arcs: read inside → work for FR now). The 2026-06 expanded scope commits **24 videos/month + 2 images/day** of exactly this testimonial short-form (posting via AYH). A cut is ON-TRACK when a real person tells a concrete book/library story; OFF-TRACK if it's a faceless program promo.
**What the client praised (keep doing):** San Quentin testimonial batch — James Davis 4/23: *"The videos are good, real good. I already posted one of Jason."* Personal, single-voice, straight-to-camera cuts.
**Hard on-screen rules:**
- **"Freedom Reads"** — two words, two r's, both capitalized (standing rule). A caption shipped "freedom reason" (2026-07-04) — the spoken "Reads and" elides; watch for it.
- **Book titles capitalized** — speakers hold real books on camera (*Heavy* — Kiese Laymon; *The Sentences That Create Us* — Caits Meissner; *The Count of Monte Cristo*; *The Wretched of the Earth*). CE01 captions repeatedly lowercase "heavy" and garbled "money crystal" for Monte Cristo.
- **Institution names verified** — Cybulski (CT), San Quentin, Niantic (see glossary). Typos in facility names got a cut kicked back before (San Quentin Juan "rehabilitation" card, 5/15).
- **Sensitivity:** speakers are formerly/currently incarcerated people telling personal stories — never sensationalize; keep the dignity-first tone of the Weekly Words series.
